row: Welcome to Miami-Dade Television, your digital video source for Miami-Dade County government news and information.  Miami-Dade TV is a Public, Education and Government (PEG) channel created to provide information about County government deliberations, services, programs, events and activities.  In addition to airing live broadcasts and rebroadcasts of Board of County Commission meetings and other government meetings, Miami-Dade TV produces a wide variety of award-winning original videos designed to inform and educate residents and visitors about County government services, events and programs, as well as public safety, arts & culture and the environment. We invite you to learn more about #OurCounty by watching Miami-Dade TV, subscribing to our YouTube channel and following us on Facebook, X and Instagram @MiamiDadeCounty. For additional information, please visit http://www.miamidade.gov or call the County’s Contact Center at 311.
